items_flat.title_en: White House accord: labs pledge four-layer AI controls, no penalties named
items_flat.title_zh: 白宮協定：六家大廠承諾四層管控，未列罰則與指定稽核方
items_flat.summary_en: President Trump released a one-page White House accord, also described as the Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities, that he said was signed with executives from Google, Anthropic, Meta, OpenAI (Greg Brockman), xAI/X (Elon Musk) and NVIDIA. Reuters and later Sep 30 coverage say the text asks for internal monitoring of training and deployment (cyber, bio, chemical), an internal team to check those controls, a partner external auditor or evaluator, and an independent board committee. Trump called it “morally binding”; the document itself says it may later be codified and names no auditor and no penalty.
items_flat.summary_zh: 川普公布一頁白宮協定（亦稱 Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities），稱已與 Google、Anthropic、Meta、OpenAI（Greg Brockman）、xAI／X（馬斯克）及 NVIDIA 高層簽署。路透與 9/30 後續報導指出文本要求：訓練與部署期間的內部監控（網安、生安、化學）、確保管控運作的內部團隊、外部稽核／評估夥伴，以及獨立董事會委員會。川普稱「道德上有約束力」；文件本身未指定稽核機構、未列罰則，並寫道未來「或許」才立法。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the first same-table written pledge covering all six tracked U.S. frontier vendors after a week of agent-safety incidents—but the product change is still undefined: who audits, on what schedule, and what happens if a lab misses a control are not in the public text. Treat it as political process, not a shipped safety standard.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是一週代理人安全事件後，六家美國前沿業者首次同桌落紙承諾；但產品層面仍未定義：誰稽核、多常做、未做到怎麼辦，公開文本都沒寫。應視為政治流程，而非已出貨的安全標準。
items_flat.quote: Over time, it may make sense to codify these steps into laws or regulations. Regardless of whether this is required of companies, we believe that implementing these controls and audits is critical to ensuring a safe future for everyone, and each of our companies are committed to doing this.
items_flat.quote_zh: 長遠來看，把這些步驟寫進法律或法規或許合理。無論是否強制，我們認為落實這些管控與稽核對所有人的安全未來至關重要，各家公司都承諾這麼做。

brief_en: Quiet official shipping window after DevDay. The story still moving is the White House voluntary “Super Intelligence” accord signed by OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, xAI and NVIDIA: four audit layers, no named auditor, no penalties. No new flagship model shipped in the last 12 hours.
brief_zh: DevDay 過後近 12 小時無新旗艦模型上線。今日可核實主軸是白宮自願「Super Intelligence」協定：OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta、xAI、NVIDIA 簽署四層稽核，未指定外部稽核方、無罰則。
